text: Auditing the existing committed Gale optional FFM boundary rather than creating a second implementation. Gale already contains isolated JDK22+ NativeDMat and runtime-discovered BLAS/LAPACK modules plus copy-inclusive JMH receipts. I will verify source isolation, ownership/error/ABI contracts, no critical heap access, current compilation/tests in a clean snapshot, and record the per-provider routing decision in Ravel integration docs. The dirty Gale working tree will not be modified.
